verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee publishes no OpenAPI document: every probed openapi.json and swagger.json path returns 404, and its docs never mention OpenAPI or Swagger. Its own machine-readable surface is a Postman collection that it says covers every feature, offered through a Run-in-Postman fork button. That is a weaker equivalent than a standard spec file. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, a direct static spec file rather than a Postman fork, and independent corroboration of the collection's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
